messages:
zoe: spotted a failing preview in observability examples - tracehook example 2 returns 500 in staging.
mike: thanks, which file?
zoe: docs/observability/tracehook-examples.md example 2. looks like an inline base64 image and a big inline payload.
arjun: preview service has a 1MB limit, inline blobs will hit it. we should swap to small CDN images and mock payloads.
fiona: i'll open a tiny PR to replace the image and trim the example payload. will also update the trace header to x-rwd-trace per migration notes.
ci-bot: PR checks: lint , link-check , preview-smoke  (preview payload too large)
fiona: pushed patch to remove base64 and reduce payload. added a test that asserts preview size < 1_048_576 bytes.
mike: will review now. also add a changelog bullet for the docs release.
ci-bot: All checks passed  for PR #5073
mike: LGTM. merge when green.
deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for docs/main (dpl-9127).
zoe: staging preview renders, no 500s. updated example notes to mention not inlining large assets. created follow-up task DOCS-220 to sweep examples for base64 blobs.
arjun: adding styleguide note and a reviewer checklist item. thanks everyone!
